name: Erika Carmel-tech Ltd.
summary: Erika Carmel-Tech Ltd. is an international company, which develops markets and distributes the B-Cure Laser products. It is designed to treat pain, orthopedic disorders, wounds and inflammations, for daily domestic use in the comfort of home; these are a series of revolutionary lightweight and portable devices. The company was founded on October 9, 2007 and is headquartered in Haifa, Israel.
